actions.name: Spend Hit Dice
actions.text: Spend one or more Hit Dice to regain HP (roll one die per die spent, adding the Constitution modifier to each).

actions.name: Recharge Short Rest Features
actions.text: Regain expended uses of Channel Divinity or other short-rest recharge abilities.
